resources.string: I-SandFly inikeza impendulo ekhulunywayo ukuze usebenzise idivayisi yakho ngaphandle kokubheka isikrini. I-SandFly ingaba wusizo kubantu abanobunzima bokubona isikrini.

Ungayisebenzisa kanjani i-SandFly
• Swayipha ngakwesokudla noma kwesobunxele ukuze uhambe phakathi kwezinto
• Thepha kabili ukuze usebenzise into
• Hudula iminwe emi-2 ukuze uskrole

Ungayivala kanjani -i-SandFly
1. KumaSethingi, thepha okuthi Sebenzisa i-SandFly. Kuzoba nohlaka. Thepha kabili kulo.
2. Kumyalezo wokuqinisekisa, thepha okuthi Misa.Kuzoba khona uhlaka. Thepha kabili kulo.
